newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One says MD Terchai resigns.
newsitem.headline: Finance One says MD Terchai resigns.

text.p: Finance One Plc said on Wednesday its managing director Thermchai Phinyawat resigned from his position, effective March 5.

The company said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand Thermchai also resigned from his posts of director at Finance One and at its unit One Holding Plc. It gave no reason for the resignation.

Finance One, Thailand's largest finance firm, is said by analysts to be hit by liquidity problems. Last Friday it signed an agreement to merge with medium-sized Thai Danu Bank to form a new combined entity under the name Thai Danu Bank.
The Securities and Exchange Commission said last week it was investigting transactions involving Finance One officials to see if they had violated insider trading regulations.
One Holding, an investment arm of Finance One, said earlier on Wednesday it had defaulted on $13.5 million due on a bill of exchange payment because of a liquidity problem.

The Stock Exchange of Thailand halted trading in One Holding shares in the afternoon session on Tuesday. Finance One shares have been suspended since March 3 when news of the merger with Thai Danu first broke.
